text: The refund is real on the bill and fiction in the pocket, and the truck rides the difference.
name: Della Okafor

text: The fee is small and the account is small, and small ones are the ones that multiply. I priced that in.
name: Vera Halloway

text: The escrow cushion is mine until they count it, and then it is theirs.
name: Denise Adeyemi
